title: Session Cookie Policy Compiler
description: Compiles session and cookie security configuration. Enforces: HttpOnly and Secure flags set, expiration defined, CSRF protection declared.

error_codes.SK001: session-spec.json missing or invalid — required fields: cookie{}, csrf{}, session{}
error_codes.SK002: Session cookie missing HttpOnly or Secure flag — both are required to prevent XSS and MITM theft
error_codes.SK003: Session expiration not defined — set both maxAge (idle) and absoluteExpiry (max session lifetime)
error_codes.SK004: CSRF protection not declared — specify mechanism: samesite-strict, double-submit-cookie, or synchronizer-token
error_codes.SK006: Session token not rotated after login — set session.rotate_on_login: true to prevent session fixation attacks
